To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the dark current in carbon nanotubes photo-detectors can be reduced by employing a double-gate structure.

(a) the photo-current can be significantly enhanced in a double-gate carbon nanotube transistor by applying a gate voltage on the back gate, (b) the dark current can be significantly reduced by using a double-gate device, and (c) the ratio of the photo current to the dark current is enhanced by more than two orders of magnitude by applying a negative gate voltage on the front gate.
the dark-current can be reduced significantly by employing a double-gate structure and by using a gate voltage that shifts the Fermi level to the center of the band-gap.
